tasks.title: 实现生产协议状态机
evidence: work/src/Bridge.Relay/ (CommandJournal + CommandDispatcher + IClock + RelayBackend): faithful C# port of contract_lab ContractEngine

State machine accepted->executing->succeeded/failed/uncertain/cancelled; journal INSERT 'executing' BEFORE side effect (single tx: +next_sequence, active_command_id, consume observation); duplicate returns stored receipt (duplicate=true, no 2nd effect); same id + different binding -> IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; restart recovery marks unfinished 'uncertain'/PROCESS_RESTART_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN + epoch+1 + leases cleared + observations deleted

Outcome mapping: ABORTED_BEFORE_BACKEND->cancelled, BACKEND_RETURNED->succeeded, STOP_OR_EXPIRY_DURING_EXECUTION->uncertain, BACKEND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED->failed, other exceptions (incl. timeout)->uncertain/BACKEND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; receipt cap 8192 bytes; monotonic deadlines survive wall-clock rollback

Bridge.Relay.Tests: 16/16 passed (453ms) mirroring lab cases incl. fixture click (-1720,100), floor edges (0,0)->(-1920,0) (959,539)->(-2,1078), key-order dedup, duplicate-after-expiry, crash-restart-no-replay, unknown-backend-uncertain, abort-during-execute-uncertain

Reference baseline re-run: contract_lab 35/35 OK (2026-11-13). Solution builds 0 warnings 0 errors; Microsoft.Data.Sqlite bumped 10.0.0->10.0.15 (NU1903 vuln warning cleared); contracts 23/23 still passing
